typingLines: I turn raw data into decisions.
intro: Final-year B.Tech student in Computer Science (AI & Data Science) who completed a six-month Data Analyst internship at Krios Info Solutions. I build data pipelines, BI dashboards and grounded AI applications that are measured, tested and honest about their limits.
openTo: Open to Data Analyst, Data Engineer and AI/ML roles · Graduating 2027
about: I'm a final-year Computer Science (AI & Data Science) student at Pimpri Chinchwad University, Pune, graduating in 2027 with a CGPA of 8.3. From May to November 2026 I worked as a Data Analyst Intern at Krios Info Solutions, building Tableau and Power BI dashboards for enterprise clients and the Python and SQL pipelines that clean and validate the data behind them.

Outside work I build end-to-end projects: data pipelines and BI dashboards, agentic AI with LangGraph, hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense + reranking) with citation checking, FastAPI backends on PostgreSQL / Supabase, and full-stack apps deployed to the cloud. I care about measuring what I build: benchmarks, automated tests, CI and honest notes on limitations.
I'm looking for full-time roles in data analytics, data engineering and applied AI, where I can work on real business problems and keep learning from experienced teams.

contact.message: Whether it's an internship, a full-time role or a project collaboration, I'd love to hear from you. The quickest way to reach me is email or LinkedIn.
